verdict.rationale: Asana markets AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Asana Dash as generating insights/suggestions from work data with shared memory and Work Graph context, which directly supports AI-generated insights inside the product. However, this is vendor-only documentation with no independent/hands-on verification of insight quality or accuracy, and community evidence is silent on these AI features specifically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of the AI insights/suggestions, concrete examples of generated output, and community feedback on the AI features themselves.
